phase_order.detail: g_model_hooks.source_query_6c; a null result returns 0 immediately with no further mutation
when the index query does not return -1: singleton lookup, virtual call at vtable+0x2c with (index, DAT_015d68a8, cookie), slot lookup for tag 0x051ce36a, then release of a non-null result
three independent if-blocks; the halfword is zeroed first and the dword mirror is then re-read from it
init descriptor built with vftable = source 0x08, tag 0x030bdee3, arg = source 0x10; the handle is only released when the local slot is non-null, and it is null on entry so the release never fires
a non-zero fetch gates the name query, the wide comparison and both vtable calls
six scalar words and nine row words, then trailing_dc
child_finish_30 on the array bounds, then the four staging calls with the record count
counts cleared for the whole local buffer, then counts[record[i].parent_index] incremented when the index is in range
per record: factory at type 0x0e08 named Editor, construct, guarded assign into the child array, then the count seed
a single call between the creation loop and the population loop
per record, in the order recorded in population_order
bound republish from the source, then release of a non-null mode handle, then return 1

population_order: bit 0x2000000 of child bits_dcc set or cleared from record flag 0x081
if record 0x00c != -1: either clear link_3e0 (releasing the previous value when the flag is set) or assign link_3e0, then assign link_3e4
if record 0x008 != -1: assign link_33c, acquire the child, call the bridge helper with the held pointer, release it
copy 9 words from record 0x038 to child 0xa8, then 9 words from record 0x05c to child 0xf0
compose the 9-word matrix into child 0x60 from child 0xf0 and child 0xa8
publish record 0x084 and 0x088, then record 0x08c with the 0.0f to 0x3f800000 substitution into child 0x1d4
set or clear bit 0x1000 of child bits_dc8 from record flag 0x080
self-append range A (0x94 .. 0x94 + record 0x090) and range B (0xb4 .. 0xb4 + record 0x090)
for each of the record 0x0d4 entries: look up the node, then write 7 words (0x00, 0x04, 0x08, 0x0c, 0x10, 0x14, 0x18)
branch_order: the null-source early return at the top is the only early exit that skips the tail
the index branch is gated on != -1
each select mirror block is independent
the mode-fetch block is gated on a non-zero fetch word
the named vtable call is gated on a three-way wide-string comparison against DAT_013ec468 being non-zero; the tag vtable call is unconditional inside the fetch block
each per-record link block is gated on its index sentinel
the 0.0f substitution is a select, not a branch
the bitfield updates are selects between masked set and masked clear
the entry loop is gated on the record entry count
mutation_order_notes: link_3e0 is nulled before the previous pointer is released, so a re-entrant release sees the slot already cleared
the bridge helper receives the address of the local held pointer, not the child, and may replace it before the release
child->owner_28 is written before any link or field mutation for that record
the histogram is fully built before any child is created, so creation order does not depend on link state

null_and_sentinel_behavior.index_sentinel: record indices 0x008 and 0x00c use -1 as the disabled sentinel; the comparison is signed

null_and_sentinel_behavior.entry_node_null: not guarded; the 7-word store would be an invalid write
null_and_sentinel_behavior.record_count_zero: all four staging calls and both per-record loops still run, each zero times

runtime_gate.reason: 22 callees are represented by hook stubs, so only the control flow, field writes and call ordering of this function are validated; no native body is exercised

unresolved_gates: the copy-back semantics of FUN_0041cb40 inside FUN_00423320 are unresolved; the second operand is an uninitialised stack slot in the decompilation, so the matrix result cannot be reproduced numerically and is delegated to a hook
the second argument of the FUN_00454420 entry lookup is an uninitialised register at this call site and is not modelled
FUN_00454420 reads param_1+0x46 of its receiver, which is outside the 0x1d8 record stride, so the receiver type is not established
record indices are read as dwords and compared against -1; whether they are genuinely signed sentinels or unsigned 0xffffffff is not proven
the local histogram is bounded at 512 entries in the model; the native local array extent is not recoverable, so a record count above 512 would diverge
receiver and record class identities are unresolved because the binary has no RTTI and vtable detection never ran headless
semantic meaning of the 0x1d4 field and of the 0x3a0 row is not established by static evidence
known_model_divergences: the histogram is capped at 512 words with an explicit range guard so the model never overruns; the native code has no such guard
FUN_0041cb40, FUN_00454420 and every other callee body are replaced by hooks, so the model asserts ordering and target-field effects rather than numeric results
